title: Finance Manager – Costing, Compliance & Collections
description:
**Key Responsibilities:** Team Leadership & Core Accounting Operations **Manage, mentor, and track a 4-member finance pod covering Accounts Payable (AP), General Ledger (GL), Collections/Receivables, and Tax & Compliance.**  Lead rigorous monthly, quarterly, and annual book closures on Tally Prime and Zoho Books, ensuring absolute ledger hygiene across multi-state branch systems. **Serve as the primary corporate anchor for external statutory audits, internal controls validation, and direct/indirect tax audits.**

**Collections & Working Capital Command :**Take absolute ownership of corporate collections, managing complex, multi-stage milestone billing frameworks typical of NHAI, municipal smart cities, and government contractors. **Implement aggressive cash collection strategies and risk monitoring to drastically mitigate working capital blockage and tracking retention money timelines.**  Oversee the operational lifecycle of Bid Security, Earnest Money Deposits (EMDs), and Performance Bank Guarantees (PBGs) for all domestic tenders.

**GST, Direct Tax & Full Regulatory Compliance Supervise and validate flawless multi-state GST filing, reconciliations (GSTR-2B matching), dynamic TDS/TCS computations, and corporate tax compliance framework.**  Ensure full adherence to FEMA guidelines, local corporate secretarial provisions, and standard trade compliances. **Maintain foundational oversight of domestic and international Transfer Pricing regulations to guarantee legally defensible, arm's-length documentation for dealings with UK and Germany entities**

Specialized Costing & Tender Bid Engineering : **Build and enforce granular Bills of Materials (BOM) costing setups, inventory tracking, and margin controls for camera manufacturing, product development, and specialized police vehicle integrations (Bike & Car Interceptors).**  Establish site-by-site, real-time profitability trackers for data survey deployments and field operations. **Partner with sales and procurement teams during the pre-bid stage to review commercial clauses, pricing structures, and financial compliance on the GeM portal.**

Data Intelligence & BI Management Reporting :

**Utilize Advanced Excel and Business Intelligence (BI) platforms (such as Power BI or Tableau) to model data pipelines, financial variances, and strategic metrics.**  Translate complex operational and accounting sets into visually scannable dashboards and cash flow forecasts directly for the CFO.

Required Profile & Technical Competencies **Education:**

**Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.**

Experience: 5 to 8 years of post-qualification experience in tech-hardware manufacturing, smart mobility, defense/security electronics, or public infrastructure contracting fields. **Team Leadership: Minimum 2-3 years of proven experience directly managing a team of accounting and compliance professionals.**  Software Mastery: Expert hands-on operational knowledge of Tally Prime and Zoho Books. **Analytics Suite: Expert-level capabilities in Advanced Excel (modeling, macros) and modern Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau).**  Domain Expertise: Clear tracking history with government procurement processes, GeM portal workflows, joint ventures/consortium accounting, and milestone settlement patterns. **Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills to align with cross-functional project teams, contractors, and executive leadership**

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Financial Analyst-Systems
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

* What's in it for you?

  **Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**  
  Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.

  Impact In This Role

  As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will assist with financial planning and budgeting, analyze financial statements and be responsible for the support and maintenance of our FP&A and Accounting systems, build and validate multiple reports for the Finance teams, make sure various integrations are supported and maintained, and keep up-to-date knowledge of system needs for customization and integration. The ideal candidate is passionate about Fictiv, has strong financial knowledge and analytical skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. This position will have the opportunity to interact with multiple finance and technical teams across Fictiv, providing a broad exposure to the business. This is a senior role: we're looking for someone who can shape how Finance and Business Applications work together, not just operate within the systems and processes already in place.

  You will report to the Manager FP&A.

  What You'll Be Doing

  + Be responsible for the support, planning, analysis, and delivery of our key financial tools, as well as running and maintaining their integration with other Fictiv's systems.
  + Liaise with multiple stakeholders across the organization to ensure that the planning tools are up and running and to ensure minimal downtime.
  + Assist with the recurring forecasting, budgeting, and month-end close.
  + Automate data retrieval tasks via reports & dashboards.
  + Lead or participate in the development and implementation of new systems and new reports and administer those reports going forward.
  + Maintain an in-depth understanding of existing business application architecture, including integrations and data structures.
  + Assess and standardize financial processes across all global regions and entities, accounting for local requirements, and ensure they are supported consistently in NetSuite and the planning tools
  + Identify the data needs for Financial tasks and communicate with Data teams and other business partners to close the gaps.
  + Troubleshoot problems that Finance's teams encounter with Fictiv's tools and systems, including but not limited to the planning tools, NetSuite ERP, Salesforce, and Sigma.
  + Interface with external software vendors for product issues, troubleshooting and resolution; initiating Service Requests (SR's) as necessary with other 3rd Party Vendors.
  + Liaise and act as representative for Fictiv FP&A to other systems teams within the organization.
  + Identify, evaluate, and recommend other key technologies required to support and improve the business process centered around existing systems.

  Desired Traits

  + This is a senior-level role. Candidates must have a demonstrated track record of driving change in cross-functional financial systems and processes — not simply executing within existing workflows and constraints, or finding workarounds within them. This means having personally identified a broken financial process, built the business case for a fix grounded in financial impact, pushed back where needed, and seen it through to a resolution with a systems or technology team. Candidates who can only operate within existing systems and processes are not a fit for this role.
  + 8+ years in a similar role, with a proven record of operating at a senior level — preferred at a technology or manufacturing related business.
  + A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field is required. A Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
  + Required experience with implementation and management of financial planning systems such as Hyperion/ NSPB or Anaplan.
  + Experience with NetSuite and/or Oracle ERP systems (required); experience with Salesforce, Odoo, Sigma (desirable).
  + Ability to translate financial and business processes into ERP system design — understanding not just what the finance process should be, but how to map it to the actual system setup.
  + Understanding of manufacturing and supply chain operations and inter-company dynamics, with the ability to map that to financial processes — grasping the operational realities specific to the business well enough to design the right financial process.
  + Has served as a system owner or administrator for an ERP or FP&A platform — not just a power user or requester of changes — with experience leading a system implementation or major upgrade end-to-end, from requirements through go-live.
  + Track record of partnering directly with IT/Business Applications leadership to shape system design decisions, and comfortable presenting recommendations and trade-offs to senior finance and business leaders — including pushing back on requests that don't hold up.
  + Skills in tools for efficiently querying large databases.
  + Expertise with MS Office suite and G. suite.
  + Understanding of Financial Statements and Finance and Accounting principles.
  + Extremely organized with the ability to work on and manage multiple projects within tight timelines.
  + Strong attention to details.
  + Strong interpersonal skills, written and verbal communication, and facilitation skills.
  + Self-motivated, proactive, willing to learn, strong sense of accountability, and a proven track record of delivering results.
  + Must work well under pressure, be sensitive to deadlines, be able to interact in a team environment, be able to adapt quickly to change, and possess excellent analytical, problem solving and customer service skills.
  + Must be able to troubleshoot, resolve, and communicate solutions for system issues to the stakeholders.

We're actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Accounting Manager - India BRS
description:
**About Kaseya**

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

**Position Summary**

The Manager, Bank Reconciliation Services (BRS), leads global bank reconciliation and cash accounting operations across multiple legal entities and geographies, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely reconciliations. The role owns operational delivery, month-end close activities, exception resolution, financial controls, and continuous improvement while partnering with Treasury, Accounting, AP, AR, Cash Applications, and Controllership teams. The successful candidate will bring strong accounting expertise, people leadership, process improvement capability, and financial systems knowledge to a high-volume global environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end bank reconciliation and cash accounting activities for multiple global entities and bank accounts, ensuring daily, weekly, and month-end deliverables meet established SLAs.
* Review and approve reconciliations, monitor aged reconciling items, and drive timely resolution of outstanding exceptions and unidentified transactions.
* Coordinate month-end close activities related to bank reconciliations and cash accounting, including review and approval of reconciliation-related journal entries and clearance of open items.
* Maintain strong internal controls over cash and balance sheet accounts; ensure compliance with company policies and audit requirements, and support internal and external audit requests.
* Investigate complex reconciliation discrepancies and partner with Treasury, Cash Applications, AP, AR, Accounting, and Finance teams to identify root causes, resolve issues, and prevent recurring exceptions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the reconciliation team by setting performance goals, allocating workload, coaching team members, and ensuring business continuity, quality, productivity, and SLA adherence.
* Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement using tools and systems such as Oracle, Kyriba, FloQast, or equivalent; maintain SOPs, process documentation, and reconciliation guidelines.
* Serve as the primary stakeholder for reconciliation-related matters, provide KPI and management reporting, and support finance transformation, cash management, and system implementation initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Bank Reconciliation, Cash Accounting, Record-to-Report (R2R), or General Ledger operations.
* 3+ years of people management experience with demonstrated ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of month-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, financial controls, exception management, and audit requirements.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPA, CA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
* Experience working in multinational organizations and global finance shared services environments.
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or equivalent, along with advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
* Experience with Treasury Management Systems such as Kyriba and reconciliation/workflow tools such as FloQast or equivalent.
* Experience identifying automation opportunities and delivering process improvements that increase reconciliation efficiency, accuracy, and control.
* Demonstrated experience partnering cross-functionally with Treasury, Controllership, FP&A, Internal Audit, Tax, and Shared Services teams.

title: Junior Finance and Accounts Executive
description:
##### **Who we're looking for?**

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Finance & Accounts Executive to join our Finance team. The person will work closely with the Finance Manager and support the day-to-day execution of accounting, finance operations, compliance activities, internal coordination, and management reporting.
  
The role is suitable for someone who is hands-on, organised, comfortable following up with multiple stakeholders, and interested in gaining broad finance experience in a startup environment.

##### **What you will be doing?**

If you're hired for this role, you will be taking up the following responsibilities among others:

* Accounting & Bookkeeping
  + Handle day-to-day accounting entries and maintain accurate books of accounts in Tally.
  + Record purchase invoices, sales invoices, expenses, reimbursements, receipts, and payments.
  + Maintain proper ledgers and supporting documentation.
  + Perform bank, vendor, customer, and other ledger reconciliations.
  + Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

* Accounts Payable & Receivable
  + Process vendor invoices and maintain payment trackers.
  + Coordinate internally for invoice approvals and supporting documents.
  + Track customer receivables and follow up with relevant internal teams for collections.
  + Maintain ageing reports for receivables and payables.
  + Assist in preparing payment schedules and ensuring approved payments are processed on time.

* Finance Operations & Compliance Support
  + Assist the Finance Manager with GST, TDS, PF and other statutory compliance-related data and documentation.
  + Maintain compliance trackers and ensure required information/documents are available within timelines.
  + Coordinate with CA, CS, banks, auditors and other external stakeholders for routine requirements.
  + Maintain proper records of invoices, challans, agreements, bank documents and other finance documentation.

* MIS & Reporting
  + Assist in preparing monthly and weekly financial/MIS reports.
  + Prepare and update reports relating to:
    - Revenue and collections
    - Receivables and payables
    - Cash and bank balances
    - Expenses and budget utilisation
    - Monthly P&L and other management reports
  + Support the Finance Manager in cash-flow preparation, budgeting and variance analysis.
  + Gather and organise financial data required for management and investor reporting.

* Internal Coordination & Execution
  + Act as a coordination point between the Finance team and other departments for finance-related requirements.
  + Follow up with Sales, Operations, HR and other teams for invoices, approvals, expense documents, collections and other pending information.
  + Maintain trackers for open finance items and ensure timely closure.
  + Take ownership of routine operational finance activities and escalate exceptions or delays appropriately.

##### **What you'll need to bring to the table?**

* B.Com / BBA Finance / M.Com / MBA Finance or similar Finance/Accounting qualification.
* 1 - 3 years of experience in accounting, finance operations or a similar role preferred.
* Good understanding of accounting fundamentals.
* Hands-on knowledge of Tally.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate and follow up effectively with multiple stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership and meet deadlines.

###### **Good to have:**

* Basic understanding of GST, TDS and other statutory compliances.

##### **What we are looking for?**

More than just an accountant, we are looking for someone who can execute and close tasks. The person should be comfortable maintaining trackers, following up with teams, identifying missing information, preparing reports and ensuring routine finance activities do not remain pending.
  
The role will work directly with the Finance Manager and provide execution support across Accounting, Finance Operations, MIS, Banking and Compliance.

**Reports to:** Finance Manager

description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**What a Finance Manager does at Visa:**

CDPE is seeking a Finance Manager who combines strong finance judgment, structured problem solving and delivery discipline to support cross-functional data and process improvement initiatives. The Manager will support the coordination of Controllership participation in the Finance Data Platform (FDP), translate business priorities into clear requirements and delivery plans, and support initiatives from problem definition through implementation, adoption and measurable outcomes. The role will also support management reporting, operational delivery, controls, process improvement, automation and approved GenAI solutions based on business priorities.

**Essential Function:**

**ATR Data & Digital Enablement Support (Project-Based)**

* Support the Accounting and Reporting team on a project basis by developing, maintaining, and automating data extraction, report generation, and analytics solutions.
* Partner closely with MSC to identify reporting requirements, streamline manual download and centralize data workflows as activities transition from markets into the MSC operating model.
* Design scalable reporting solutions, improving data quality and governance, enabling self-service reporting where appropriate, and working with ATR digital team to digitalize and standardize processes to enhance efficiency, control, and scalability across the organization.

**Oversee Management Reporting and Operational Delivery:**

* Responsible for management reporting and other operational work performed by the team to help ensure timely, accurate and complete delivery
* Process data and reporting requests, review outputs, monitor timelines and dependencies, and follow up on issues or exceptions that could affect delivery quality
* Escalate material risks, delays, errors or quality concerns promptly when required
* Ensure process documentation is established, maintained, and updated to reflect current procedures and controls

**Support Finance Data Platform Coordination and Adoption:**

* Support coordination across Controllership teams, FDP partners, data governance and technology stakeholders to progress priority finance use cases
* Establish the intake and prioritization of FDP requirements, including use cases, business rules, source data, calculation logic, acceptance criteria and target outcomes
* Support data validation, reconciliation, user acceptance testing, issue resolution and business certification to help ensure delivered data is complete, accurate, controlled and fit for purpose
* Support the transition from manual extracts and spreadsheet-dependent reporting to governed FDP data products, including ownership, documentation, adoption and retirement planning

**Convert Strategy and Insights into Measurable Delivery:**

* Translate Controllership priorities into a structured portfolio of initiatives, delivery roadmaps and actionable workplans
* Define success measures and track business outcomes such as improved cycle time, fewer errors, stronger controls, increased automation, higher adoption and lower manual effort
* Support stakeholder alignment and decision-making to resolve dependencies and maintain delivery momentum
* Provide concise executive updates on progress, risks, decisions, benefits and required actions

**Support Responsible GenAI and Automation Adoption:**

* Support the identification and prioritization of finance use cases for approved GenAI and automation tools based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, scalability and control considerations
* Support the translation of finance use cases into solution requirements, prompts, decision logic, workflows, controls and expected outputs
* Support pilots and implementation of GenAI-enabled solutions that improve analysis, decisions, follow-up activities or operational workflows
* Ensure solution outputs are validated for accuracy, relevance, consistency, usability, security and control considerations before business use
* Maintain appropriate documentation and support ownership, human review, monitoring and continuous-improvement practices for responsible adoption

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**To succeed in this role, you will need to have:**

* A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems or a related field, with 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Relevant experience in finance, accounting, controllership, finance transformation, data or process improvement, with demonstrated ownership of cross-functional initiatives
* Experience supporting projects or workstreams from requirements definition through testing, implementation, adoption and benefits realization
* Experience overseeing management reporting or operational deliverables, with a strong focus on timeliness, accuracy, issue resolution and escalation
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, including the ability to provide concise updates and recommendations to senior stakeholders
* Comfort using approved GenAI and automation tools, including Claude, to accelerate analysis, solution design and workflow improvement
* Ability to manage changing priorities and contribute across multiple Controllership initiatives as a flexible, hands-on problem solver
* Strong intellectual curiosity and growth mindset, with a willingness to learn emerging technologies and continuously improve processes and ways of working
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global team environment

**What will also help:**

* Experience coordinating finance data platform or data warehouse initiatives, including use-case intake, source-to-target mapping, data validation, UAT, business certification and adoption
* Experience in continuous improvement, Lean Six Sigma, controls, audit, issue management or root-cause analysis
* Experience using GenAI, prompt engineering, AI agents or AI-enabled workflows to solve business problems
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, Power BI, Power Query, Power Apps, Power Automate or other analysis, visualization and automation tools
* Experience supporting delivery governance, project documentation, change adoption, benefit tracking and executive stakeholder updates
* Awareness of finance data governance, access controls, data lineage, responsible AI and model or solution monitoring considerations
* Experience supporting or guiding analysts and cross-functional contributors without relying on formal authority

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Product Lead, Accounting Platform
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


We are looking for a Product Lead to lead Rippling’s Accounting Platform.

  

You will own the accountant experience across Rippling’s Finance and Payroll products. Your mandate spans two important problems. First, you will own the accounting infrastructure and ERP integrations required for Rippling to serve larger and more complex customers. Second, you will define the future of the accounting product at Rippling by building AI\-powered workflows that automate the close process.

  

Rippling sits in a unique position between the systems where business activity originates and the ERP where the official books live. This gives us the context to automate work that accountants perform manually today, from validating transactions before they reach the GL to reconciliation and period\-end adjustments.

  

Over time, the opportunity is to expand this platform beyond supporting Rippling’s existing products and build a complete accounting close experience that can become a product in its own right.

 **What you will do**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for Rippling’s Accounting Platform.
* Build a world\-class accounting experience across Finance and Payroll.
* Develop AI\-powered accounting workflows that help customers keep their books complete and current.
* Automate core close processes such as transaction validation, reconciliation, and period\-end adjustments.
* Build the platform capabilities needed to support complex ERP environments and larger customers.
* Improve the reliability and scalability of the systems that move financial data from Rippling into customers’ general ledgers.
* Work closely with Finance, Payroll, Procurement, and Data teams to build shared accounting capabilities.
* Spend significant time with controllers and accounting teams to understand how they work and where Rippling can eliminate manual effort.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design from product discovery through launch.
* Define clear measures of customer and business impact, then use them to prioritize the roadmap.

 **What you will need**

* 8\+ years of product management experience, ideally working on complex B2B software.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear strategy.
* Experience building technically complex products that depend on integrations, data models, or platform infrastructure.
* A strong understanding of accounting workflows and the financial systems businesses use to run them.
* The ability to work closely with engineers on complex system and data problems.
* Strong customer instincts and a willingness to learn detailed accounting workflows firsthand.
* High ownership. You should be comfortable setting direction and making decisions in a fast\-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.  

  

**Nice to have**

* Experience building accounting, ERP, fintech, or financial operations products.
* Familiarity with systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, or Microsoft Dynamics.
* Experience with month\-end close, reconciliation, transaction coding, or financial integrations.
* Experience building AI agents or AI\-powered workflow products.
* Experience building products for controllers, accountants, or enterprise finance teams.

title: Asset Management Risk Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best\-in\-class.


As an Asset Wealth Management Analyst in Asset Management Risk, you will support the AM Investment Risk Team in managing investment risks across our Private Equity portfolios within the Alternatives Business, with a primary focus on monitoring portfolios and highlighting emerging risks.


This position combines rigorous analysis with collaborative teamwork to support sound risk management practices. You will support proactive management of investment, liquidity, and counterparty risk based on ongoing, informed, and educated market observations with a focus on Private Equity within the Alternatives business. Working closely with investment teams and control functions, you will help develop and maintain understanding of risk profiles of funds and portfolios and contribute to the enhancement of risk oversight processes as the platform evolves.


This role provides the opportunity to work on a global Alternatives platform where you will collaborate with experienced professionals and contribute to risk management practices in a growing business. We are looking for a professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with intellectual curiosity and an interest in private equity investment risk.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Measure, monitor, and independently assess risks in Private Equity investment activities; escalate issues and concerns to senior management
* Monitor stress, performance, liquidity, and counterparty risk metrics against thresholds and perform deep\-dive risk analysis on outliers
* Collaborate with investment, in\-business, and independent risk teams to develop and maintain understanding of risk profiles of Private Equity funds and portfolios
* Support improvements to transparency and infrastructure for capturing and reporting risk exposures
* Identify and highlight emerging risks across Private Equity portfolios, assessing potential impact to the business
* Look for innovation opportunities in risk oversight processes, policies, and procedures for Investment, Liquidity and Counterparty Risk, ensuring compliance is maintained

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**


* Bachelor's degree required
* Up to 2 years of experience in financial services industry related to trading, portfolio management, risk management, and/or investment risk across asset classes.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills; inquisitive nature and comfortable in challenging current practices
* Strong quantitative skills with curiosity and ability to pursue analysis and deep dive risk reviews independently
* Prior experience with coding and data visualization tools such as Python, SQL \& Tableau
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills for effective business interaction

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**


* Post\-graduate degree or additional certifications such as CFA or CAIA
* Buy\-side and alternatives experience strongly preferred
* Familiarity with modeling and working knowledge of portfolio valuations and risk systems
* Familiarity with market risk methodologies, including, stress testing, and sensitivities
* Experience in alternatives risk, particularly within private equity

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Meet the Team
  
  

JoinCisco Capital APJC, a high\-growth, high\-impact organization focused on accelerating business bookings and enabling growth across the region. The Finance team serves as a strategic partner toSales Leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders, helping enable bookings while balancing financial performance, risk, and business objectives.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

As aFinance Leader supporting Cisco Capital APJC, you will play a critical role in driving regional business performance, growth, and financial outcomes. Supporting$1B\+ in annual bookings and a sales organization of more than 30 sellers, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, using financial expertise, modeling, and business insights to influence strategic decisions.
  
You will lead and develop a team ofthree finance professionals while partnering across Sales, Finance, Credit, Operations, and Compliance to structure commercial opportunities, optimize profitability, and support sustainable business growth.
  
  

What You’ll Do
  
  

You will direct and enable$1B\+ in annual APJC bookings, serving as a strategic finance partner to the Cisco Capital Sales Leader and APJC VP of Finance.
  
You will lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team of three finance professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous development.
  
You will spearheadcomplex deal negotiations and cross\-functional alignment across Commercial Finance, Sales Finance, Cisco Capital Credit, Operations, and Compliance.
  
You will structure and execute tailored financing solutions that balancerevenue growth, credit risk, profitability, and Cisco’s broader financial objectives.
  
You will monitor booking margins, discount structures, and profitability trends and provide actionable recommendations to support growth while maintaining strong financial performance.
  
You will leverage financial analysis, modeling, forecasting, and business planning to provide insights that support leadership decision\-making and improve operational efficiency.
  
  

Who You’ll Work With
  
  

You will partner closely withCisco Capital Sales Leadership, APJC Finance Leadership, Commercial Finance, Sales Finance, Cisco Capital Credit, Operations, Compliance, and other cross\-functional stakeholders across the region.
  
  

Who You Are
  
  

You are a strategic and commercially minded Finance leader who can connectfinancial insights with business outcomes. You are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex deals, leading teams, and making decisions in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
  
You bring strong financial judgment, analytical capability, communication skills, and the ability to simplify complex information into clear recommendations and compelling business stories.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree inFinance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Proven experience inSales Finance, Commercial Finance, FP, or Business Operations.
* Experience withfinancial planning, reporting, and business performance management systems.
* Strong financial analysis and business partnering skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams in a complex business environment.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience supportingSales organizations within the technology or corporate sector.
* Strong capabilities infinancial modeling, forecasting, scenario analysis, and business planning.
* Experience with complex commercial transactions, deal structuring, pricing, or profitability analysis.
* Experience managing and developing finance teams.
* Ability to operate effectively within amatrixed, global, and highly collaborative environment.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate complex financial insights throughclear and compelling business storytelling.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Product Lead, Finance Experience
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**


We’re hiring a Product Lead to run the Finance Experience team, a new team that owns shared experiences across the finance suite: forms, permissions, policies, notifications, and APIs. In this role, you will identify how the suite can share common solutions to many customers’ problems, and build towards a consistent admin\- and employee\-facing UX across our finance suite. You’ll define a vision for the suite’s shared experiences and share that vision with PMs and engineers across the organization. This role will work with a dedicated engineering team and will closely collaborate with all teams in the suite.

 **What you will do**

* Define the vision and roadmap for the Finance Experience team, who are responsible for shared products across the Finance suite.
* Own the admin configuration experience for the suite as we go further upmarket, ensuring that admins can seamlessly configure dynamic policies, workflows, reports, forms, and permissions.
* Own the employee\-facing experience for custom forms, approvals, notifications, and tasks within the Finance suite to build a world\-class, consumer\-grade product.
* Partner with platform teams to ensure that the Rippling platform is evolving in ways that are compatible with the needs of our finance users.
* Partner with engineering, design, and go\-to\-market teams to launch polished features that move the needle with new and existing customers.
* Build for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex customers, and generalize those learnings into products that can serve thousands more.
* Make thoughtful prioritization calls across customer commitments, platform reliability, and strategic AI investments.

 **What you will need**

* 7\+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to finance or spend management systems, enterprise software, no\-code automation tools, or other B2B SaaS.
* Systems thinking: You can find the common denominators of 5\+ finance products (and understand the customer needs they address), and design solutions that work across the suite.
* AI\-pilled: You understand that AI changes the way work happens, for yourself, your team, and your customers. You fold AI into the products you build for customers, and you leverage AI in your day\-to\-day work to maximize your efficiency.
* Technical judgment: You understand the data models that compose the system, identify where designs will fail, and partner with engineering to build products that are reliable, scalable, and easy for customers to trust.
* Customer empathy and judgment: You can find the root causes for customer issues and understand the underlying flexibility they need, and you can build the product customers will love using.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity, make tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, design, support, implementation, and GTM teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: You can convince product and engineering leaders across the suite to adopt your products, and you can distill the needs of customers to make technical arguments in favor of your solutions.
* Bias for ownership and follow\-through: You don’t just ship features; you own whether the workflow works in production.


If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

 **Nice to have**

* Experience as a product manager on a platform team balancing the needs of multiple downstream product teams
* Experience building products for enterprise or multi\-entity customers
* Experience as a software engineer is not required, but can help thinking
* Experience building AI\-assisted or automated operational workflows is a plus.

title: Process Analyst - PE Fund Accounting

title: Principal Analyst Accounts Payable
description:
**Job Title: Principal Analyst Accounts Payable, USA Operations**

  

**About GF**

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power\-efficient and high\-performance solutions for high\-growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted technology partner serving customers worldwide. GF’s global team remains focused on security, longevity, and sustainability.

  

  

**Introduction**

The Accounts Payable Manager, USA Operations is responsible for leading end\-to\-end Accounts Payable (AP) operations for the United States region within GlobalFoundries' global finance organization. This role provides operational leadership, ensures strong internal controls and compliance, drives process excellence, and partners closely with Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Treasury, Tax, and business stakeholders. The successful candidate will combine financial acumen, leadership capability, and continuous improvement expertise to deliver world\-class AP services while supporting business objectives, working capital optimization, and transformation initiatives.

  

  

**Your Job**

  

**AP Operations Management**

* Lead daily Accounts Payable operations for the USA region.
* Ensure timely and accurate processing of supplier invoices, payment requests, employee reimbursements, and vendor credits.
* Monitor AP aging, blocked invoices, GRIR balances, and unresolved exceptions and drive prompt resolution.
* Review operational performance metrics and implement corrective actions to maintain service\-level commitments.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end financial close activities related to Accounts Payable.
* Coordinate tax\-sensitive supplier payment activities, including support for 1099 reporting, withholding reviews, and collaboration with Tax and Compliance teams.
  

  

**Stakeholder and Supplier Management**

* Serve as the primary AP contact for USA business stakeholders, Procurement, Supply Chain, Logistics, Accounting, Treasury, and suppliers.
* Lead escalations involving invoice processing, supplier disputes, payment delays, and system\-related issues.
* Partner with suppliers to improve invoice quality, compliance, and payment efficiency.
* Build strong relationships with internal customers to deliver exceptional service and effective issue resolution.
  

  

**Controls, Compliance and Risk Management**

* Ensure adherence to company policies, delegated authority requirements, SOX controls, and audit standards.
* Monitor AP control environments, segregation of duties, approval workflows, and payment governance.
* Support internal and external audits and participate in remediation efforts when required.
* Oversee supplier banking validation processes and fraud\-prevention controls.
  

  

**Working Capital and Financial Performance**

* Collaborate with Finance and Treasury teams to optimize payment timing and support working capital objectives.
* Monitor AP performance metrics, DPO trends, discount capture opportunities, and payment efficiency.
* Analyze operational and financial data to identify risks and process improvement opportunities.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, and management insights for Finance leadership.
  

  

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Accounts Payable team members to achieve individual and organizational goals.
* Establish clear performance expectations, accountability measures, and development plans.
* Foster a culture of customer focus, operational excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support workforce planning, cross\-training, succession planning, and talent development initiatives.
  

  

**Continuous Improvement and Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to streamline AP processes and eliminate non\-value\-added activities.
* Partner with IT and business stakeholders on automation, workflow, and system enhancement initiatives.
* Participate in SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP VIM, Ariba, OCR, and AP transformation projects.
* Lead business testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), training, and change management activities for new solutions.
  

  

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Invoice processing cycle time
* DPO performance
* Blocked invoice aging
* Supplier satisfaction
* Past\-due invoice volume
* Compliance and audit performance
* Supplier payment timeliness
* Productivity and automation adoption
* AP close performance
* Team engagement and development
  

  

**Other Responsibilities**

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety \& Security requirements and programs.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification such as CPA, CMA, or MBA is preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of progressive Accounts Payable, Shared Services, or Finance Operations experience.
* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing Accounts Payable teams in a large corporate environment.
* Experience supporting complex, multi\-site business operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading process improvement and transformation initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP VIM, Ariba, or similar ERP platforms.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel, reporting, and analytics capabilities.
* Experience with workflow automation and Accounts Payable technologies.

**Additional Requirements**

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams and drive operational improvements.
* Demonstrated knowledge of internal controls, compliance requirements, and audit processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPA, CMA, MBA, or equivalent advanced qualification.
* Experience within a global shared services environment.
* Exposure to AP automation, digital transformation, and intelligent workflow technologies.
* Experience managing outsourced service providers.
* Advanced analytics and dashboard development capabilities.
* Knowledge of USA supplier tax reporting and regulatory requirements.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Operational Excellence
* Collaboration and Influence
* Customer and Supplier Focus
* Talent Development
* Financial Acumen
* Problem Solving and Decision Making
* Strategic Thinking
* Continuous Improvement Mindset
* Change Leadership
* Risk and Control Awareness

**Role Scope**

* Regional ownership for United States Accounts Payable operations within a global AP organization.
* Direct leadership of AP analysts, AP specialists, senior AP analysts, and/or outsourced AP service provider teams as applicable.
* Accountability for operational performance, controls compliance, stakeholder engagement, talent development, and transformation initiatives.
  

  

**Equal Opportunity \& Compliance Statement**

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to local laws and regulations. GlobalFoundries maintains a strict no recruitment fee policy and candidates will not be charged at any stage of the hiring process.

  

Information about our benefits you can find here: https://gf.com/about\-us/careers/opportunities\-asia

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**You will have an immediate impact by tightening our local compliance footprint and ensuring our Indian statutory reporting is bulletproof. Working closely under the guidance of your Singapore\-based manager, you will serve as the localized expert who reviews global transactions, flags compliance issues early, and collaborates regionally on how to resolve them.**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Key functions within ALM include balance sheet and NIR forecasting and interest rate risk (IRR) management which are supported by groups focused on data analytics, balance sheet modeling and senior management and Board reporting. ALM is also responsible for coordinating the company’s deposit pricing strategy, return on capital and funds transfer pricing methodologies and balance sheet strategy. ALM works closely with other functions across Global Treasury, Finance, Risk Management and Business Units.

**Key Responsibilities \& Experience Range**

* Report and analyze actual balance sheet, NII and IRR trends to support month\-end and quarter\-end processes
* Respond in a timely and accurate manner to ad\-hoc requests

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of postgraduate degree, preferably in Finance or related field, MBA preferred and having FRM and CFA qualification is a plus
* 8\-12 Years of experience in banking, financial services. Treasury ALM related experience preferred

**Skills/ Knowledge:**

* Ability to influence others and lead a team in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; effective at presenting results to key stakeholders including senior management and external regulators
* Strong quantitative aptitude/skills and experience modeling complex financial concepts
* Detail oriented and effective written and verbal communication skills
* Experience using software applications to define and solve complex business problems
* Knowledge of financial markets
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment
* Must possess strong communication skills with ability to participate in conference calls and contribute to presentation of financial results to financial and non\-financial audiences at various levels of seniority

title: Finance Analyst - Reporting
description:
**We’re Pentland Brands:** a global family business behind some of the world’s most iconic active and lifestyle brands. We bring integrity, energy and ambition to our work, setting high standards and striving to deliver great outcomes without ego.

**Design cycling apparel built for movement, endurance and the ride ahead.**


At Pentland Brands, every role helps move our brands forward. Whether you’re supporting our people, improving our systems, growing our commercial performance, strengthening operations or shaping better ways of working, your impact reaches across a portfolio of iconic brands used by consumers around the world.


This role will play a key role in supporting the Marketing team with financial insight, spend tracking, and planning. Working closely with the Senior Marketing Business Partner and wider FP\&A team to deliver effective cost control, forecasting, and commercial analysis.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Support marketing spend tracking and forecasting, ensuring alignment to budgets and providing timely visibility of cost commitments, phasing, and variances against plan.
* Own data gathering and validation from Marketing stakeholders, ensuring accuracy of inputs for forecasts, actuals, and budget submissions into OneStream.
* Build and maintain simple, robust financial models to evaluate marketing investments, campaign ROI, and brand spend effectiveness.
* Deliver monthly marketing performance analysis, linking spend to brand and commercial outcomes and highlighting key drivers, risks, and opportunities to stakeholders.
* Support month\-end close activities for marketing cost areas, including transaction coding validation in SAP/BW and preparation of variance commentary.
* Contribute to the preparation of monthly and quarterly reports and presentations for communication to Marketing leadership and wider Finance stakeholders.
* Support initial brand analysis and commentary, translating financial data into clear, structured messages that marketing teams can use in their decision\-making.
* Learn and apply financial analysis techniques with support from the FP\&A Manager and Senior Marketing Business Partner, developing capability in commercial finance over time.

**What you’ll bring:**

* CA/ICWA/ACCA/ MBA (Finance) or equivalent fully qualified with 2\+ years of relevant experience; with years of relevant finance experience.
* Experience in FP\&A or commercial finance roles, with exposure to marketing cost analysis, campaign economics, or brand finance considered a strong advantage.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – able to present financial information clearly and concisely to non\-finance audiences, build trusted relationships with Marketing teams, and influence decisions through insight rather than seniority.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills, with the ability to handle and interpret high volumes of data from multiple sources accurately and efficiently.
* Analytical mindset with a commercial curiosity – interested in understanding what drives brand performance, not just what the numbers say.
* Ability to work with a range of stakeholders across Finance and Marketing in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, managing multiple deadlines with agility and precision.
* Detail\-oriented with a track record of accuracy in financial reporting and data management, desirable having familiarity with SAP, BW, or OneStream (or equivalent ERP/EPM systems).

**Why Pentland Brands?**


Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best\-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.


We are a global family business with a clear purpose: pioneering brands that make life better. Across our teams, functions and locations, we work together to create products, experiences and partnerships that help people live more active, confident and positive lives.


Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks \& Benefits**


Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident \& term life insurance cover.

**The Interview Process**


We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

* **Talent Team Intro Call** \- A 30\-minute video call with our Talent Team to get to know each other, talk through the role and your experience, and answer any questions you have.
* **Experience Interview** \- A more in\-depth interview (usually online) with the hiring manager to explore your skills, experience and approach, and how these align with the role, our principles, and our ways of working.
* **Final Interview** \- A final in\-person interview at our office, focused on deeper discussion and practical application, giving you the chance to meet more of the team and see Pentland Brands in action.

* Chartered Accountant/Cost Accountant/master’s degree in finance, or Business Administration
  

Required Experience 6\+ years of overall finance experience

  

**Critical**

* A Capable finance professional who has the intellectual curiosity and an attitude in going above and beyond to partner with the business in commercial excellence.
* Exposure to Global Customers with ability to interact effectively with all levels of employees/customers and align and integrate with other departments / sites.
* Strategic Partner with Corporate Finance and Functional leaders to manage financial targets for the function.
* Prior exposure of driving business finance metrics
* Exposure to Tools like Power BI, Advance excel etc.
* Knowledge of ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, Essbase, HANA/BW and Hyperion
* The ability to quickly identify subtle patterns among issues and to make consistent, timely decisions
* Strong cross functional and peer influencing skills.

title: Sr Analyst, Tax
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.


Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.


**Job Summary:**


This job is responsible for preparing complex tax returns and provisions with precision while reviewing the work of junior staff to ensure accuracy and completeness. It supports audits and communicates with tax authorities as needed. The role contributes to maintaining strong compliance by applying technical expertise and assisting with tax research or issue resolution.
**Job Description:**


**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Prepare complex returns and provisions with a high degree of accuracy.
* Review tax filings prepared by junior team members.
* Support audits and interactions with tax authorities.

**Minimum Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:**


**Subsidiary:**


PayPal
**Travel Percent:**


0
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us.


For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.


**Our Benefits:**


At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.


**Who We Are:**

  


**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.


**Belonging at PayPal:**


Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.


Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.


We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.
